Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in its initial analysis by hallucinating specific geographical facts that were not supported by the available evidence or general knowledge at that stage. Specifically, it incorrectly asserted that "Tabulam is the town on the banks of a river" and that it sits on the "Clarence River" without verifying this information. While the WebSurfer search results visible in the conversation snippet did not explicitly confirm Tabulam as the next town or the river name (showing mostly location metadata and unrelated links), the Planner proceeded to define the entire solution path based on this unverified internal assumption, leading directly to the wrong answer (Clarence River) instead of the correct one (Tweed River, associated with Murwillumbah). The Planner failed to instruct the WebSurfer to specifically look for the next town and its associated river, instead making a definitive claim before verification.
